QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] Big Sister Ephenia
QuestInfo.0: The atmosphere between Ephenia and the girl is pretty tense. Listen in.
QuestInfo.1: Ephenia let the girl go, but now she wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.2: Turns out Ephenia is an avid fan of the Pale Student Teacher. She asked you to keep an eye out for those who like him and disappeared.
